sources.name: Demailly-agbook.pdf
sources.judgment: The full8.5 argument and8.6 proof,8.7 proof and8.12 symmetry establish the task-permitted compact-Kahler parity background. For degree1, b1=h10+h01=2h10. The radial Hopf quotient is explicitly S1 x S3, hence b1=1. A putative Kahler product metric restricts to a Kahler metric on its compact Y fiber, contradicting parity. All recursively cited Hodge foundations are not claimed recertified.

A local exact smooth correction identifies the curve product as 1_{r>minus-infinity}(a omega1+ddc r). The full current has mass a by distributional Stokes; domination by the smooth nonpolar target of mass a removes every polar remainder. No nonclosed full-product mass invariance is used. Proposition1.4 local and current-invariance proofs were read; its omitted multilinearity proof is not claimed read or used for an unbounded assertion.
